newsitem.title: USA: Stanley Works names Trani chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Stanley Works names Trani chairman, CEO.

text.p: The Stanley Works said on Thursday it elected John Trani chairman and chief executive officer, replacing Richard Ayers, who previously announced his retirement.

Trani, 51, has been employed by General Electric Co since 1978, the company said. Since 1986, he has been president and chief executive officer of GE Medical Systems. Stanley Works said Trani's appointment concluded a search by the board to fill the chairman and CEO position.
Ayers will assist in the transition, which begins today, the company said.
Stanley Works produces tools, hardware and specialty hardware.
